main_menu.title: R P y G - L E G A C Y
main_menu.tagline: Your CPU will handle all the dragons
main_menu.lore:
In a world where dragons roam the skies and ancient magic floats in the air, you are a brave adventurer seeking glory and fortune. 
Will you rise to the challenges ahead and become a legend?

messages.already_explored: You have already searched this place.

entry_village.name: Entry Village
entry_village.description: A small village that serves as the starting point for adventurers.

village_square.name: Village Square
village_square.description: The bustling center of the village, filled with villagers and market stalls.
village_square.look_around: You see villagers going about their daily routines, children playing, and merchants selling their goods.

blacksmith_shop.name: Blacksmith Shop
blacksmith_shop.description: A small workshop filled with the sounds of hammering metal.
blacksmith_shop.look_around: You see the blacksmith working diligently, crafting weapons and armor.

village_gate.name: Village Gate
village_gate.description: The main entrance to the village, guarded by vigilant sentries.
village_gate.look_around: You see the guards keeping watch and travelers coming and going through the gate.

tavern.name: Tavern
tavern.description: A cozy tavern where villagers gather to relax and share stories.
tavern.look_around: You see villagers enjoying their drinks and chatting with each other.

flooded_cave.name: Flooded Cave
flooded_cave.description: A dark cave partially submerged in water, with the sound of dripping echoing through the chambers.

entrance.name: Cave Entrance
entrance.description: The entrance to the cave, where the water begins to pool.
entrance.look_around: You see the water slowly rising and the dark interior of the cave beckoning you in.

water_pool.name: Water Pool
water_pool.description: A deep pool of water within the cave, reflecting the dim light from above.
water_pool.look_around: You see the water shimmering and hear the distant drip of water echoing through the cave.

narrow_passage.name: Narrow Passage
narrow_passage.description: A tight, winding passage within the cave, barely wide enough to squeeze through.
narrow_passage.look_around: You see the walls of the passage closing in and the faint light from the water pool behind you.

sunken_grotto.name: Sunken Grotto
sunken_grotto.description: A vast flooded chamber at the end of the passage. Black water fills it almost to the walls, and something long moves beneath the surface.
sunken_grotto.look_around: Ripples cross the dark water though no wind blows. Old bones line the narrow ledge you stand on.

dripping_hollow.name: Dripping Hollow
dripping_hollow.description: A low, damp hollow where water seeps from every crack. Rats nest in the crevices.
dripping_hollow.look_around: Scratching echoes from the walls. No matter how many you chase off, more always come back.

bat_roost.name: Bat Roost
bat_roost.description: A high chamber whose ceiling is lost in darkness. The floor is thick with droppings.
bat_roost.look_around: Hundreds of small shapes hang overhead, stirring at the slightest noise.

miners_camp.name: Old Miners' Camp
miners_camp.description: The remains of a camp: a cold fire pit, a broken cart and rusted tools.
miners_camp.look_around: Among the debris, a battered crate still seems intact.

whispering_woods.name: Whispering Woods
whispering_woods.description: An old forest west of the village, where the wind never stops murmuring through the leaves.

forest_edge.name: Forest Edge
forest_edge.description: The village fields give way to tall, crooked trees. A muddy trail leads north into the woods.
forest_edge.look_around: Fresh tracks churn the mud: something heavy and tusked often passes here.

clearing.name: Sunlit Clearing
clearing.description: A wide clearing where light finally reaches the ground. Trails leave in every direction.
clearing.look_around: Gnawed bones lie in the grass, and you hear howling not far away.

old_oak.name: Old Oak
old_oak.description: A colossal oak, its trunk split by lightning. The ground around it is torn up and trampled.
old_oak.look_around: Deep gouges scar the bark at shoulder height. Whatever made them is big.

hunters_hut.name: Hunter's Hut
hunters_hut.description: A small abandoned hut of mossy logs. The door hangs open on a single hinge.
hunters_hut.look_around: Snares and empty racks hang from the walls. Someone left in a hurry.

wooden_sword.name: Wooden Sword
wooden_sword.description: A basic wooden sword, suitable for beginners.

wooden_shield.name: Wooden Shield
wooden_shield.description: A simple wooden shield. Better than nothing.

heal_potion.name: Healing Potion
heal_potion.description: A healing potion that restores a good amount of health.

wooden_club.name: Wooden Club
wooden_club.description: A heavy wooden club. Slow, but it hits hard.

wooden_dagger.name: Wooden Dagger
wooden_dagger.description: A light wooden dagger. Weak blows, but quick and precise.

wooden_staff.name: Wooden Staff
wooden_staff.description: A long wooden staff, held with both hands.

medicinal_herb.name: Medicinal Herb
medicinal_herb.description: A common herb that soothes small wounds.

cave_rat.name: Cave Rat
cave_rat.description: A fat, mangy rat that lurks in damp tunnels. Quick, but frail.

cave_bat.name: Cave Bat
cave_bat.description: A shrieking bat that dives from the ceiling. Fast, but its bite is weak.

black_eel.name: Black Eel
black_eel.description: A huge eel as dark as the water it hides in. It strikes in quick, repeated bites before anyone can react.

wild_boar.name: Wild Boar
wild_boar.description: A bristly boar with sharp tusks. It charges anything that enters its territory.

forest_wolf.name: Forest Wolf
forest_wolf.description: A lean grey wolf that hunts in pairs. Quick and relentless.

old_boar.name: Old Boar
old_boar.description: A huge, scarred boar, master of the woods. Its thick hide turns aside the weakest blows.
